name: Gazuntype
industry: Gaming / Indie Video Game & VR Development
what_they_do: Nigerian indie game and VR development studio (Gazuntype Entertainment, led by solo developer Tade Ajiboye) creating adventure, sports, action, and VR titles including Go North, Home VR, Battle of the Lake, Top Spy, and Soccer Battle.
recent_activity: 2026-10-28: Selected among 10 African studios for Google Play's $1M Indie Games Fund Africa for its title Go North (https://www.startuplist.africa/funding/gazuntype-grant-undisclosed-2826c91); 2026-11-06: Profiled in African-Startups coverage of the Google Play Indie Games Fund winners (https://african-startups.com/news/funding/meet-the-10-african-gaming-studios-selected-for-google-plays-1-million-indie-games-fund/)
round_type: Non-dilutive Grant (Google Play Indie Games Fund Africa 2026)
amount: Not disclosed ($1M total fund across 10 studios)
marketing_titles_found: NONE (gazuntype.com is a solo developer portfolio for Tade Ajiboye with a 2023 footer and no public team page or marketing/growth/content title)
hiring_marketing_role: NO (no careers or open roles page on gazuntype.com)
unique_offer: Nigerian solo-founded indie and VR game studio creating exploration and simulation titles like Go North and Home VR backed by Google Play's Indie Games Fund.
pitch_hook: Gazuntype won Google Play Indie Games Fund Africa backing on 2026-10-28 for Go North, yet gazuntype.com is still a minimal 2023-copyright portfolio with zero game descriptions, no blog, no Instagram presence, and no marketing or growth support.
